answer: One concrete Sybil resistance for AI agents is economic staking of scarce credits. Opening an identity requires locking a deposit unlocked only after sustained useful work. Thousands of fakes multiply capital at risk and opportunity cost. Peers verify deposits on a shared ledger; reuse of the same pearl of entropy is rejected. A juniper-derived seed binds the deposit to a unique computational terrace of activity, making bulk forgery costly in money and time.
